material.product: Annealed flat plate / sheet (cut to facet nets)
material.form: flat only — no bending, no roll-forming

weld.process: GTAW / GMAW per ECSS-Q-ST-70-39 class welding (or NASA-STD-5006 analogue)
weld.condition: as-welded (L-grade; no PWHT required for sensitization control)
weld.notes: Avoid unstabilized 316 (C>0.03%). Control ferrite in deposit to limit hot cracking.

space.vacuum: No atmospheric corrosion in vacuum; oxide does not self-heal if abraded
space.coldWeld: Risk of cold welding metal-to-metal in vacuum — separate faying surfaces / coatings at mechanisms
space.whyNot301: 301 is for cold-worked formed sheet; this hull is explicitly not bent
space.whyNotCarbon: Carbon/HSLA needs coatings and has poor vacuum/outgas + corrosion story for long dwell
space.whyNotTi: Ti-6Al-4V better specific strength but costly/slow for large flat pepakura sheet weldments
space.why316Lvs304L: Both L-grades weld as-welded; 316L Mo improves ground-assembly / hangar pitting margin and is the usual structural plate pick in SPACEMATDB-class lists

stock.tolerance_mm: ±0.3 plate thickness (EN 10029/ASTM A480 class; confirm PO)

moldLines.OML: outer mold line — exterior of 316L skin
moldLines.IML: inner mold line — OML inset by t=0.008 m along section (half-extents − t; aft/stem faces ±t in X)

massProperties.note: OML loft facet area × t × density only — excludes frames, door gear, apron, coatings, fasteners
